messages:
noah (docs): FYI I'm landing a refresh of streaming + pagination examples to prefer async iterators and explicit resume-token flows. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012
yuki (eng-runtime): nice. please surface how KV cache interactions can lead to partial-prefixes on reconnects. people expect exact resume but it's best-effort.
clare (eng-ml): also add a short reconciliation note about model quantization swaps causing occasional token duplication/truncation. a one-liner under "compatibility" should do.
noah (docs): ok will add both. i'm proposing three tiny examples intended for copy-paste:
- python: async-for with a small exponential backoff helper and explicit resume_token handling
- typescript: AbortController + for-await-of + `resume_token` param demonstrated
- go: idiomatic context + channel read + resume-token reattach example
omar (eng-platform): heads up: snippet-harness hit a timeout for the go example earlier. CI log: https://ci.internal/snippets/9988 - please add a context timeout in the snippet.
ci-bot: snippet-harness: failed job `docs-snippets` - examples/go/stream-resume.go line 21 (context deadline exceeded)
yuki (eng-runtime): TS sample should show how to cancel and then reattach with a resume token. tiny code suggestion:
```ts
const controller = new AbortController();
setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 5000);
for await (const chunk of client.stream({ model: 'redwood-mini', input: p, resume_token }, { signal: controller.signal })) {
  console.log(chunk.text);
}
```
noah (docs): thanks, i'll include that and call out that `resume_token` is best-effort and not persisted across model variants.
clare (eng-ml): can we add a short test plan in the PR description: unit mock for resume path + integration snippet check in snippet-harness? i can add the mock.
noah (docs): please do. also debating whether to keep legacy callback examples. suggestion: keep a single `legacy/callbacks.md` with an explicit deprecation note and link to migration guide.
yuki (eng-runtime): yep archive them. add a migration table: callback -> iterator equivalences (e.g., on_chunk => async-iter yield, on_error => thrown exception).
omar (eng-platform): lint: snippet filenames must be kebab-case. also added a small harness tweak to bypass flakey local sockets. will rerun after you push.
noah (docs): updated filenames, added go context.WithTimeout, and added migration table + compatibility note about quantized models. pushed branch.
ci-bot: snippet-harness: all checks passed on branch docs/stream-iter-snippets.
docs-bot: created issue #712 "add e2e for resume-token reconnection" and assigned to eng-runtime.
yuki (eng-runtime): I'll draft the e2e. one more ask: include a short "cost note" that long-lived streams still consume tokens while open (so people don't accidentally keep connections open).
noah (docs): added a short paragraph under "cost & best practices". final reviewers: @yuki @clare @omar 94 please thumbs if good.
clare (eng-ml): lgtm.
omar (eng-platform): lgtm. landing in 10m. :shipit:
noah (docs): merging in ~10. thanks all! :tada:
